learned_operation_rule: Collect candidate hrefs before save; use bounded scroll to discover more links; save only observed same-origin links and avoid start_url/exclude_urls.
assumptions_and_limits: Observed learning articles use /learn/ paths and are linked from the main content. Apply this category path pattern to other listings; scroll may reveal more. Up to max_items are saved; only same-origin links with nonempty labels are eligible.
